background: Koko Knudtson is the Sheridan County assessor. The Sheridan Press reported on January 21, 2026, that after Assessor Paul Fall retired at the beginning of the year, the county commission appointed Knudtson to serve through at least the end of 2026. In a Sheridan Media announcement she wrote that she was appointed on January 20, 2026. The official assessor page states that she has more than 20 years of service to Sheridan County, has served in multiple roles in the Assessor's Office, and oversees valuation of residential, commercial, agricultural, and industrial property under Wyoming law. She was unopposed in the November 2026 general election.
